status.title: Authenticator app

intro.step2: Scan the QR code we show you, or type the setup key by hand.
intro.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app displays to confirm. You then receive recovery codes.

setup.manualHint: Enter this setup key in the app instead. Time-based, 6 digits.
setup.codeHint: Enter the code the app shows right now.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.body: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, apart from your password.
codes.saved: I have stored these recovery codes safely.
codes.fileHeader: Platform console recovery codes for {email}. Each code works once.

risks.title: Risk items to review
risks.empty: All clear. No failures or warnings in the last 7 days.

quickActions.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can run these actions.

enforcement.title: What each control does today
enforcement.description: Saving a setting is not the same as the platform acting on it. Enforced means something checks it now, partial means only some paths check it, reserved means it is stored for later.

requireMfaForAll.label: Require 2FA for all users
requireMfaForAll.hint: Every workspace user must set up an authenticator app before continuing.

requireMfaForAdmins.label: Require 2FA for admins
requireMfaForAdmins.hint: Users with the Admin role in any workspace must set up an authenticator app.

requireMfaForSuperAdmins.label: Require 2FA for super admins
requireMfaForSuperAdmins.hint: Platform super admins sign in with a password alone while this is off. Turning it on makes them enrol and use an authenticator app.

requireMfaForOwners.label: Require 2FA for workspace owners
requireMfaForOwners.hint: The owner of each workspace must set up an authenticator app.

allowedMfaMethods.label: Allowed 2FA methods
allowedMfaMethods.hint: At least one stays selected: leaving none ticked keeps the saved list. Only authenticator apps exist today.

sessionTimeoutMinutes.label: Session timeout (minutes)
sessionTimeoutMinutes.hint: Idle time before a browser-session sign-in ends. Sessions kept for 30 days are exempt.

maxConcurrentSessions.label: Max concurrent sessions per user
maxConcurrentSessions.hint: When exceeded, the oldest session is signed out.

rememberMeEnabled.label: Allow keep me signed in
rememberMeEnabled.hint: Off means every session ends when the browser closes.

lockoutAfterFailures.label: Max login attempts
lockoutAfterFailures.hint: Failed sign-ins within the window before the account is paused.

lockoutWindowMinutes.label: Lockout window (minutes)
lockoutWindowMinutes.hint: How long failures are counted and how long the pause lasts.

passwordBlocklistEnabled.label: Block common passwords
passwordBlocklistEnabled.hint: Refuses the most common passwords, look-alike variants such as P@ssw0rd, keyboard patterns, and anything containing the person's name or email.

passwordBreachCheck.label: Block passwords from data breaches
passwordBreachCheck.hint: Checks new passwords against the public Pwned Passwords list. Only the first five characters of a hash leave the server. If the service cannot be reached, the password is accepted.

explain.off: No checks run. The caps and filters on these tabs have no effect.
explain.monitor: Checks run and matches are written to the event log, but no message is stopped. Use this to confirm the rules before enforcing them.
explain.enforce: Matching messages are blocked before they are sent.

waHoldOnLinksCount.label: Hold if links exceed
waHoldOnLinksCount.hint: Messages with more links than this are held. 0 means no limit.

waRequireTemplateReview.label: Require template review before send
waRequireTemplateReview.hint: Counts toward the security score only; nothing checks it yet.

abuseBlockFinanceTerms.label: Block finance and get-rich terms
abuseBlockFinanceTerms.hint: Fake investment, guaranteed returns and payment redirection patterns.

abuseBlockShortLinks.label: Block short and suspicious links
abuseBlockShortLinks.hint: Link shorteners that hide where a message leads.

abuseBlockKeywordList.label: Custom keyword blocklist
abuseBlockKeywordList.hint: One per line, or separated by commas. Up to 5,000 characters in all. Matching is not case sensitive. Matching messages are flagged or blocked according to the guardrail mode.

apiRateLimitPerMinute.label: API requests per minute
apiRateLimitPerMinute.hint: The most requests per minute any one workspace API key can make. A key can have a lower limit of its own, never a higher one.

webhookSignatureRequired.label: Require HMAC signatures
webhookSignatureRequired.hint: A webhook endpoint cannot be created without a signing secret.

webhookReplayWindowSec.label: Webhook replay window (seconds)
webhookReplayWindowSec.hint: Stored for later; incoming provider webhooks are already signature-checked.

deviceTrustRequired.label: Require trusted browser
deviceTrustRequired.hint: Stored for later; there is no device-trust flow yet.

deviceLogoutOnInactiveDays.label: Auto-logout after inactive (days)
deviceLogoutOnInactiveDays.hint: Linked WhatsApp devices unseen for this long are marked disconnected. 0 means never.

ipAllowlistEnabled.label: Enable allowlist
ipAllowlistEnabled.hint: Only the addresses below can reach this console.

alertOnNewDevice.label: New-device alerts
alertOnNewDevice.hint: Email the user when a sign-in comes from a device not seen before.

alertOnNewCountry.label: Network-change alerts
alertOnNewCountry.hint: Email the user when a sign-in comes from a different network than usual.

alertChannel.label: Where login alerts go
alertChannel.hint: Only email is sent today; the WhatsApp channel is recorded for later.

password.title: New-password rules
password.note: Applied when a password is created or changed, never to an existing sign-in, so tightening them cannot lock anyone out.

mfa.title: 2FA enforcement
mfa.description: Applies to workspace users. Platform operators who are super admins always need 2FA.

master.title: Guardrail enforcement
master.description: The caps and filters on these tabs only act according to this mode. Choose a mode and read what it does.

health.title: Workspace health
health.body: Block and flag counts per workspace appear here once the sending pipelines report them. Until then, use the security event log to see what the guardrails caught.

aside.title: Keep this policy strict
aside.body: These filters keep scams, phishing and harassment out of the channels your customers use. They follow the guardrail mode set on the WhatsApp guardrails tab.

allowlist.title: Console access
allowlist.description: Restricts this operator console only. Workspace users, the public API and webhooks are not affected. An empty list lets everyone in, so it can never lock all operators out.
allowlist.cidrsHint: One address or range per line, for example 203.0.113.9 or 203.0.113.0/24. Commas also work.
allowlist.yourIp: Your address as the API sees it:
allowlist.yourIpUnknown: We could not detect your address, so we cannot warn you about locking yourself out.
allowlist.lockoutWarning: Your address {ip} is not on this list. Saving would lock you out, so the server will refuse it. Add your address first.

audit.title: Retention
audit.description: Security events older than this are pruned once the prune job exists.

danger.title: Irreversible platform-wide actions
danger.description: Each action asks you to type its name before anything happens, and each one is written to the security event log.
danger.superAdminOnly: These actions are for super admins only. Your role is {role}.

forceReset.title: Force password reset for all users

rotate.title: Rotate all webhook secrets
rotate.note: Webhook signing secrets belong to the integrations area, which does not exist yet, so this reports 0 rotated for now.

notes.revoke: When every session is ended, including yours.
notes.forceReset: When every user is told to choose a new password.
notes.rotate: When secrets are rotated, with the count.
notes.halt: When the stop is engaged, and again when sends resume.
notes.policy: On any setting change above, with the old and new values.

halted.title: Emergency stop is on
halted.body: Every outbound message is blocked platform-wide until sends are resumed.

revoke_sessions.title: Revoke all sessions
revoke_sessions.body: Everyone signed in to a workspace or to this console is signed out, including you.
revoke_sessions.effect1: Each person must sign in again, with two-factor if it is on.
revoke_sessions.effect2: Work they have not saved in the browser may be lost.
revoke_sessions.done: {count, plural, =0 {No sessions were active.} one {# session revoked.} other {# sessions revoked.}}
revoke_sessions.signedOut: You have been signed out as well. Sign in again to continue.

force_password_reset.title: Force password reset for all users
force_password_reset.body: Every workspace user will be asked to choose a new password the next time they use the app.
force_password_reset.effect1: Nobody is signed out right now; the prompt appears on their next request.
force_password_reset.effect2: People who ignore the prompt cannot use the app until they change it.
force_password_reset.done: {count, plural, =0 {No users were flagged.} one {# user must choose a new password.} other {# users must choose a new password.}}

rotate_webhook_secrets.title: Rotate all webhook secrets
rotate_webhook_secrets.body: Every webhook signing secret is replaced with a new one.
rotate_webhook_secrets.effect1: Integrations that verify signatures stop working until they use the new secret.
rotate_webhook_secrets.effect2: There is no way to bring back the old secrets.
rotate_webhook_secrets.done: {count, plural, =0 {0 secrets rotated.} one {# secret rotated.} other {# secrets rotated.}}
rotate_webhook_secrets.noneRotated: Nothing was rotated because the integrations area does not store webhook secrets yet.

halt_sends.title: Emergency stop all sends
halt_sends.body: Every outbound message across all workspaces is refused until you resume sends.
halt_sends.effect1: Customers receive nothing, including replies, campaigns and automations.
halt_sends.effect2: Use resume sends to switch messaging back on.
halt_sends.done: Emergency stop is on. All outbound sends are blocked.

resume_sends.title: Resume sends
resume_sends.body: Outbound messaging switches back on for every workspace.
resume_sends.effect1: Messages that were refused during the stop are not sent automatically.
resume_sends.effect2: Check the event log first if you stopped sends because of an incident.

dialog.phraseHint: Capital letters and extra spaces are ignored.

errors.forbidden: Only a super admin can run this action.

policy.title: Who can register
policy.description: These settings apply to new sign-ups, including social sign-up.

publicRegistration.label: Public registration
publicRegistration.hintOn: Anyone can create a workspace from the sign-up page.
publicRegistration.hintOff: The sign-up page shows a registration closed message. Existing users are not affected.

explain.off: New accounts count as verified straight away. No verification email is needed.
explain.banner: People can use the app right away and see a reminder until they verify.
explain.block: People must verify their email before they can use anything else.

defaultPlanId.label: Default plan
defaultPlanId.hint: The plan new workspaces start on. Automatic uses the plan marked as the sign-up default, else the first active free plan.
defaultPlanId.loadFailed: The plan list could not be loaded.

trialDays.label: Free trial (days)
trialDays.hint: Whole number from {min} to {max}. 0 means no trial. Leave blank to keep the saved value.

defaultTimezone.label: Default timezone
defaultTimezone.hint: Used for new workspaces until they choose their own.

defaultCountryIso.label: Default country
defaultCountryIso.hint: Pre-selects the phone country on sign-up.

termsUrl.label: Terms link
termsUrl.hint: A site path or a full address, shown on the sign-up and sign-in pages.

cookiesUrl.label: Cookies link
cookiesUrl.hint: Optional. Leave empty to hide it.

otpEnabled.label: Sign-up code over WhatsApp
otpEnabled.hint: New accounts must confirm their phone number with a one-time code before the workspace is created.

otpSender.label: Sender
otpSender.hint: The connected number that sends the code. Add one with Manage senders.

businessEmailOnly.label: Work email addresses only
businessEmailOnly.hintOn: Free providers such as Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo are refused at sign-up.
businessEmailOnly.hintOff: Anyone can sign up with a free personal address.

blockDisposableEmail.label: Block temporary email
blockDisposableEmail.hintOn: Disposable and throwaway domains, and domains with no mail server, are refused.

requirePhoneVerification.label: Require a verified mobile number
requirePhoneVerification.hintOn: Every sign-up must confirm a one-time code. If the code cannot be sent, sign-up stops instead of skipping the check.
requirePhoneVerification.hintOff: The code step runs only when the sign-up code below is on.

blockedEmailDomains.label: Always blocked domains
blockedEmailDomains.hint: One domain per line. Subdomains are blocked too. These are refused even when work email only is off.

otp.title: Sign-up code
otp.description: Settings for the one-time code sent when someone signs up.

status.unsavedNote: This shows the saved settings. Save your changes to see how they apply.

explain.waba: Submitted to Meta as an authentication template. The code step switches on by itself once Meta approves it, usually within a few minutes.
explain.local: Saved as plain text for this channel. No review is needed, so it is in use now.

template.name: Name
template.stale: This template was made for a code valid for {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Create and submit again to match the validity above.

outcome.rejectedNow: Meta rejected the template. The reason is shown below; fix it and submit again.

errors.check: The status could not be read from Meta.

picker.otherSender: Save the sender to see its templates.

footer.title: Platform message footer
footer.description: Added to the end of plain-text and interactive messages sent from workspaces whose plan cannot remove branding. Templates carry their own text and skip it. A workspace on a plan that can remove branding sets its own footer, or none, in its account.
footer.label: Footer text
footer.hint: Up to {max} characters. Leave it empty to send no footer at all.
footer.saved: Platform footer saved. It applies from the next message.

guard.description: Keeps throwaway and personal addresses out and makes sure every new account has a verified mobile number. Applies to email and social sign-up.
guard.phoneOffWarning: With the mobile check off, accounts can be created without a verified number, which makes bulk fake sign-ups easier.

social.description: Let people sign in with Google or Facebook and protect the sign-in and sign-up pages with reCAPTCHA. Each one only appears once it is enabled and its keys are saved.

facebook.title: Facebook sign-in

recaptcha.versionHint: v2 shows a checkbox. v3 is invisible and scores each request.

live.title: What is live right now
live.note: A provider is live only when it is enabled and both its keys are saved. These show what is saved, not unsaved edits.

google.title: Google in four steps
google.step1: Open the Google Cloud console and pick or create a project.
google.step2: Set up the OAuth consent screen as an external app with your support email.
google.step3: Create credentials, choose OAuth client id, then Web application.
google.step4: Add the redirect URI from the form, then paste the client id and secret here.

facebook.title: Facebook in four steps
facebook.step1: Open Meta for Developers and create an app for authenticating users.
facebook.step2: Add the Facebook Login product to the app.
facebook.step3: In its settings add the redirect URI from the form.
facebook.step4: Copy the app id and secret from basic settings, paste them here, then set the app live.

recaptcha.title: reCAPTCHA keys
recaptcha.body: Register your site in the reCAPTCHA console, choose v2 or v3, and paste the site key and secret key here.

noSdk.body: Sign-in uses the standard OAuth addresses directly, so there is nothing to install. Paste the keys and switch it on.

removeSecret.liveWarning: {name} is working right now. Removing its secret switches it off until a new one is saved.
removeSecret.error: The secret could not be removed. Try again in a moment.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: The catalogue workspaces choose from. New sign-ups land on the default plan; paying for a plan arrives with billing.

empty.title: No plans yet

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: This cannot be undone. Deactivating a plan instead hides it from buyers and keeps the workspaces that are on it.
delete.inUseHint: {count, plural, one {# workspace is on this plan.} other {# workspaces are on this plan.}} Deleting is refused until they have been moved.

errors.inUse: {count, plural, one {Cannot delete: # workspace currently uses this plan.} other {Cannot delete: # workspaces currently use this plan.}} Move them to another plan, or deactivate this one instead.
errors.defaultProtected: This plan is the signup default, so it cannot be deactivated or deleted. Choose another default plan first.
errors.notFound: This plan no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.forbidden: Only super admins can change plans.

editor.slugNote: It is set when the plan is created and never changes.
editor.failed: The plan could not be saved. Try again.
editor.errorsBanner: Some fields need attention. Tabs marked with a dot have errors.

featuresUi.intro: Switch off what this plan does not include. A workspace on the plan cannot open an area whose feature is off.

limitsUi.intro: A cap stops the action once the workspace reaches it. Tick Unlimited to remove the cap.
limitsUi.unofficialOff: Only applies when unofficial WhatsApp is enabled by the platform (currently disabled).

addons.intro: Enabled add-ons are shown to workspaces on this plan in their Marketplace; they can only be used after the workspace buys them.
addons.emptyHint: Add-ons are created in the Marketplace catalogue of the operator console. Once an app has a paid pack it is listed here.
addons.loadFailed: The add-ons could not be loaded.
addons.loadFailedKept: The add-ons could not be loaded, so the current selection stays as it is unless you change it here.
addons.unknownHint: This add-on no longer exists. Untick it to remove it from the plan.
addons.packInactive: The add-on pack is switched off, so nobody can buy it.
addons.appUnpublished: The app is not published, so workspaces cannot see it yet.

featureHints.automation: The flow builder and automations that reply to and act on conversations.
featureHints.ai_assistants: AI assistants, including AI mode in the website chatbot widget.
featureHints.calling: The calling section: voice calls and call settings.
featureHints.woocommerce: Connect WooCommerce stores for order messages, cart recovery and store broadcasts.
featureHints.shopify: Connect Shopify stores for order messages, cart recovery and store broadcasts.
featureHints.remove_branding: White-label: the workspace can hide the platform branding in its footer.
featureHints.sales_pipeline: Deals, tasks and pipelines, and the pipeline figures on the dashboard.
featureHints.appointment_booking: Booking types, appointments and the public booking pages. The paid Appointments app owns this switch.
featureHints.appointment_confirm_buttons: Adds Confirm, Reschedule and Cancel buttons to the WhatsApp reminder sent before an appointment.
featureHints.appointment_rebook_steps: Follow-up messages sent after a completed appointment that ask the contact to book again.
featureHints.wa_storefront: The WhatsApp catalog and storefront area.
featureHints.inbox_sla: SLA policies and deadlines in the team inbox.
featureHints.inbox_routing: Automatic assignment of new chats: routing rules, Everyone else and waiting-queue timers. Part of the Smart routing add-on.
featureHints.inbox_assignment_sticky: Owner-first and keep-in-sync assignment, the returning-contact window and the reassign prompt. Part of the Smart routing add-on.
featureHints.waba_calling: WhatsApp calling from the inbox: calling numbers, call permissions, placing and answering calls.
featureHints.inbox_kanban: The Kanban board view of the team inbox.
featureHints.scheduled_messages: Scheduling messages to be sent later.
featureHints.marketplace: The Marketplace of mini apps and integrations.
featureHints.lead_sources: Lead sources: webhook and connector doors that turn ad and portal leads into contacts and deals.
featureHints.team_chat: Internal team chat channels and direct messages.
featureHints.public_api: The public REST API and its API keys.
featureHints.outbound_webhooks: Outbound webhook endpoints that tell other systems about events.
featureHints.invoicing: Invoices, credit notes, payments, sales orders and tax rates.
featureHints.forms_and_links: Lead capture forms and shareable links.
featureHints.extra_channels: The Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, LINE, Viber and WeChat channels.
featureHints.form_builder: Hosted and embedded web forms that create contacts in the CRM. The paid Forms app owns this switch.
featureHints.waba_groups: Create and manage WhatsApp groups from a Cloud API number: invite link, join requests, members. The number must be an Official Business Account.
featureHints.sms: Send-only SMS through Twilio or MSG91: connect senders, send SMS broadcasts and campaigns.
featureHints.help_agent: The in-app Help assistant: people ask for a task in plain words and it guides or does it on their own session, asking before anything risky. Spends AI tokens.
featureHints.email_channel: Connect Gmail and Google Workspace mailboxes to the team inbox. The paid Email app owns this switch.
featureHints.personal_history_full: Lets a personal WhatsApp number import its full chat history when it is first linked. The recent-chats import is open to every plan that has personal numbers.
featureHints.ai_crm_copilot: Finds and scores leads with AI, from the contacts in your workspace.
featureHints.lead_scoring: Scores contacts with AI and powers the growth pilot. The Lead scoring app owns this switch.
featureHints.record_assignment: Gives new contacts, companies and deals to the right sales owner by priority rules.
featureHints.team_hierarchy: Parent teams, team leads and managers who see their team and the teams below it.
featureHints.custom_roles: Create and edit roles, and choose a scope (own, team or all records) for each permission.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: How the plan is named and shown.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: What it costs and how often it bills.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Leave a cap blank for unlimited.

features.title: Features
features.description: Switch off what the plan does not include.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.hint: One short line under the name (up to {max} characters).

detail.label: Description
detail.hint: Shown on pricing pages (up to {max} characters).

amount.label: Price
amount.locked: Free and custom-quote plans have no price.

offerAmount.label: Offer price
offerAmount.hint: Optional. Must be lower than the price.

dataRetentionDays.label: Data retention (days after expiry)
dataRetentionDays.hint: Days after a paid plan lapses before the workspace's data is deleted. 0 = never. Deleting is permanent.

isActive.label: Active
isActive.hint: Inactive plans are hidden from buyers; workspaces already on one keep it.

isDefault.label: Default for sign-ups
isDefault.hint: New workspaces start here unless the registration policy names another plan. Only one plan can be the default.

isFree.label: Free plan
isFree.hint: No price. New workspaces on a free plan get the free trial.

isCustomQuote.label: Custom quote
isCustomQuote.hint: No price is shown. Buyers are sent to talk to sales.

isLifetime.label: One-time price
isLifetime.hint: Charged once, not for each billing period.

limitKeys.api_rate_limit_per_minute: API requests per minute (0 = platform default)
limitKeys.ai_form_generations_monthly: AI form builder generations per month

featureKeys.appointment_confirm_buttons: Reminder buttons: Confirm, Reschedule and Cancel
featureKeys.inbox_assignment_sticky: Smart routing: contact owner and sticky agent
featureKeys.waba_calling: Place and answer WhatsApp calls from the inbox
featureKeys.lead_sources: Lead sources (webhook and connector doors that create contacts)
featureKeys.team_chat: Team chat (internal channels and direct messages)
featureKeys.public_api: Public REST API and API keys
featureKeys.extra_channels: Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, LINE, Viber and WeChat channels
featureKeys.record_assignment: Record assignment rules (auto-assign contacts, companies and deals)

problems.money: Enter an amount such as 19 or 19.99.
problems.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
problems.whole: Enter a whole number, or leave blank for unlimited.
problems.unknownAddon: Selected add-ons that no longer exist: {count}. Untick them and save again.
problems.free_needs_zero_price: A free plan must have a price of 0.
problems.free_no_offer: A free plan cannot have an offer price.
problems.custom_no_price: A custom-quote plan shows no price: leave the price and offer empty.
problems.custom_not_free: A plan cannot be both free and custom quote.
problems.paid_needs_price: Set a price above 0, or mark the plan as free.
problems.offer_not_lower: The offer price must be lower than the plan price.
problems.default_needs_active: The signup default plan must be active.

limitHints.monthly_messages: Outbound messages sent in the calendar month. Beyond the allowance the wallet is charged.
limitHints.scheduled_messages: Scheduled messages the workspace holds, in any status. Deleting one frees its place.
limitHints.total_campaigns: Campaigns created in the plan period. Deleting a campaign does not give the place back.
limitHints.devices: Connected WhatsApp numbers. Removing one frees its place.
limitHints.users: Team members that are not deactivated.
limitHints.appointments: Appointments booked in the calendar month (pending, confirmed or completed), by their start time.
limitHints.saved_replies: Saved replies (quick replies) of the team inbox.
limitHints.routing_rules: Routing rules of the team inbox.
limitHints.api_rate_limit_per_minute: Requests per minute for each API key. 0 uses the platform default instead of unlimited.
limitHints.installed_apps: Marketplace apps and integrations installed now. Uninstalling frees a place.
limitHints.lead_sources: Lead sources (webhook and connector doors). Deleting one frees its place.
limitHints.broadcast_recipients: The largest audience one broadcast may be sent to, checked when the broadcast is created or edited.
limitHints.segments: Saved contact segments. Deleting one frees its place.
limitHints.custom_fields: Custom fields added to any module. The built-in system fields are not counted.
limitHints.team_chat_channels: Team chat channels, public and private. Deleting one frees its place.
limitHints.sla_policies: SLA policies of the team inbox.
limitHints.booking_types: Booking types behind the public booking pages.
limitHints.catalog_products: Products in the WhatsApp catalog. Deleting one frees its place.
limitHints.invoices_monthly: Invoices created in the calendar month, in any status. Voiding or deleting one does not give the month back.
limitHints.recurring_invoices: Recurring invoice schedules, in any status.
limitHints.api_keys: Active API keys. Revoking a key frees its place.
limitHints.webhooks: Outbound webhook endpoints (inbox webhooks and API webhooks together).
limitHints.ai_token_limit_monthly: Tokens the AI assistants use in the calendar month on the platform's keys. Workspaces on their own keys are not capped.
limitHints.forms: Active web forms (Forms app). Archiving a form frees its place. 0 = unlimited.
limitHints.form_submissions_monthly: Form submissions accepted in the calendar month, spam excluded. Over the cap a submission is still saved for review, never dropped. 0 = unlimited.
limitHints.ai_form_generations_monthly: AI form builder generations in the calendar month, a repair retry included. 0 = unlimited.
limitHints.sms_monthly: Outbound SMS messages sent in the calendar month. 0 = unlimited.
limitHints.email_mailboxes: Connected Gmail mailboxes (a disconnected one frees its place). 0 = unlimited.
limitHints.email_monthly: Emails sent in the calendar month, replies and campaign emails together. 0 = unlimited.
limitHints.storage_gb: Storage the workspace may hold, in GB (call recordings, chat media, mail attachments and files). 0 = unlimited. Measured only for now: nothing is blocked yet.
limitHints.teams: Teams the workspace may hold. Blank is unlimited, 0 is solo (no teams). Existing teams are never removed.

ipBlocked.title: This address is not allowed
ipBlocked.body: The operator console only accepts requests from addresses on its allowlist. The address these requests come from is not on it, so the console refused them.
ipBlocked.addressUnknown: The server could not read your address.
ipBlocked.fixBody: A super admin who can still reach the console adds this address to the IP allowlist. Nothing else about your account changes.
ipBlocked.fixPath: Security Center › API and webhooks › IP allowlist
